_week: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (Week 45). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales rose 18.8% to $55,333 on 9.8% more units (2,269). The Gift Set 12-Pack nearly tripled to $14,113 (268 units vs 91) and Flavor-Wrapped grew 83% to $11,973.
Pop Cup Kits + Popper fell 42% to $9,631: the Variety 12-Pack Kit dropped to $585 from $5,882 as stock ran low, and the 4-Pack Kit fell 36% to $4,203.
refunds: Refunds were $742 on 49 units (2.43% rate) vs $895 on 44 units (2.31%) last week; nothing points to a product problem.
pacing_reco: November is $62,404 through Nov 8, 8% ahead of the same days last year ($57,602); getting the 12-Pack and 4-Pack Kits restocked before BF/CM is the biggest lever.
ads_context: Ad spend fell 18.9% to $4,203 while ad sales rose 14.3% to $16,277, so ACoS dropped from 36.4% to 25.8%.
TACoS fell from 11.1% to 7.6%: organic sales carried the growth and ads drove 29% of sales.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords: $1,827 spend (-18%) at 32.6% ACoS, 182 orders.
Category keywords: $1,188 (-32%) at 62.8% ACoS for 69 orders. Brand defense: $357 at 16.0% ACoS, 58 orders.
Competitor targeting spent $150 for $24 in sales (1 order).
bid_moves: Lower bids on Sponsored Brands “opopop popcorn” exact in the Salty Caramel ($215 for $148) and Kit ($218 for $239) campaigns.
Cut “microwave popcorn” phrase ($124 for $104) and the SB “opopop” exact target with $69 and no sales.
Pause the 67 campaigns that spent $492 with no sales; keep “opopop popcorn kit with bowl” phrase ($84 → $807) funded.
coupons: This week: 30 coupon redemptions (35 last week).
promotions: This week: 404 promotion orders and $1,827 in promotional discounts (vs 374 and $808 last week).
Heavier discounting went with the jump in Gift Set sales.
